Adani Airports Secures Significant Equity Investment for Expansion

Adani Airports has secured INR 9,825 crore in equity investment from multiple investors, including Alpha Wave, Premji Invest, Temasek, and BlackRock. The company is also planning a $2.5 billion offshore loan refinancing, which would be the largest of its kind in India this year. These financial moves are intended to support Adani Group's expansion plans for its international airports.
